items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: it’s fun to learn that, you know Emerson said, “Do the thing you fear, and the death of fear is certain.”

ctx.x: You’ve got to keep on the run. No what happened was my father was a musician, a classical singer. And he’s from Georgia, and he took the big step of going to Kentucky to get his Masters, Colorado to get his Doctorate, then we moved to Minnesota for a teaching gig, St. Louis he had a teaching gig, and he’s finally settled in Texas, where he’s been about twelve years. But it’s just that process of getting degrees in different places. But this was a big step for our family because no one had moved out of Georgia.…
